svg.title: SLL v2: the 20-byte pseudo-header
svg.desc: The 20-byte SLL v2 pseudo-header of frame 1 of capture_sll2.pcap: protocol 0x86DD first, a zero reserved field, interface index 2, hardware type 1, packet type 4 (sent by us), address length 6 and the address e0:d5:5e:28:9b:d4 padded to 8 bytes; LinuxSll2Link keeps the interface index numeric, and the 72 bytes after the header are the IPv6 packet.
